running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick oscillates each pair between dissociated and bonded; toggle to start/pause.

bonds.label: Bonds
bonds.description: Four A-B bonds — the canvas draws a line between each pair whose length shrinks as the atoms converge and grows as they separate.

atoms.label: Atoms
atoms.description: Eight atoms — four red A on the left and four blue B on the right; each pair slides to the center (width/2) to bond, then back to its home to dissociate.

width.label: Width
width.description: Canvas width in pixels; the bond center is width/2.

period.label: Period
period.description: Phase units per full bond form-and-break cycle; larger is slower.

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.description: The vertical semipermeable membrane down the canvas middle (x=width/2); solute cannot cross it, water can.

width.label: Width
width.description: Simulation width in pixels; the membrane sits at width/2.

height.label: Height
height.description: Simulation height in pixels; bounds the random walk.

atoms.label: Atoms
atoms.description: Six large purple solute (S) atoms confined right of the membrane plus twelve small blue water (W) atoms that cross freely; water biases rightward each tick, so it accumulates on the solute side.
